intro.paragraph1: I am a full stack developer with a passion for backend and robust solutions. With experience in Node.js, TypeScript, and API architecture, I enjoy solving complex problems with clean and well-organized code.
intro.paragraph2: My main focus is on the backend, but I have experience and am comfortable with the frontend using React and Next.js. I believe the best solution is when the frontend and backend work harmoniously together.
intro.paragraph3: I prioritize strategic alignment and clarity in information exchange. I believe efficient software development depends on synchronized teams, where clear communication is the foundation for transforming complex requirements into functional solutions.
